law_name: Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK)
key_requirements: Expanded grounds for special-category data; tiered cross-border transfers (adequacy / SCCs notified to Board in 5 days / BCRs); VERBIS registration
deceased_data: Not covered: 'data subject' is a living natural person; Board decision 2019/273 rejected a spouse's art. 11 request for a deceased's records
research_exemption: Law does not apply to data anonymized for official statistics or for research, planning and statistics (art. 28(1)(c))
genetic_data: Special category (art. 6): processing prohibited unless explicit consent or another art. 6(3) exception (as amended 2024)
notes: Amended by Law 7499 (in force 2024-06-01): new transfer regime, SCC notification, special categories
